RESEARCH DAILY (2026-02-23)

- **Signals**
  - OpenAI “Operator” reportedly rolling out more broadly to Plus/Team (consumer-facing autonomous web tasking moving mainstream):  
    https://champaignmagazine.com/2026/02/22/ai-by-ai-weekly-top-5-february-16-22-2026/
  - Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 (agentic “computer-use”, long-context beta) highlighted in weekly roundups:  
    https://champaignmagazine.com/2026/02/22/ai-by-ai-weekly-top-5-february-16-22-2026/
  - Google Gemini 3.1 Pro preview positioned around agentic multi-step workflows:  
    https://jonathanberthold.com/blog/the-builders-ai-roundup-february-2026/

- **OpenClaw / MCP**
  - Google announced “Developer Knowledge API” + an MCP Server (public preview):  
    https://developers.googleblog.com/introducing-the-developer-knowledge-api-and-mcp-server/
  - MCP Server pattern showing up in security/ops tooling too (example: Virtana MCP Server):  
    https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/02/19/virtana-mcp-server/

- **Security**
  - “Clinejection” supply-chain incident (prompt injection → CI/cache poisoning → malicious publish) is a strong reminder that agent-connected tooling can bridge untrusted text into real code execution/publishing paths:  
    https://snyk.io/blog/cline-supply-chain-attack-prompt-injection-github-actions/

- **Recommended actions**
  - Add a lightweight **tooling guardrail checklist** for OpenClaw skills: don’t run package-manager commands (npm/pip/brew) from model-supplied text; require explicit confirmation and show the exact command first.
  - **Pin + audit:** enforce lockfiles, prefer `npm ci`, and add a dependency-diff review step before updating any skill/tool deps (especially those with install scripts).
